# NATURO GROUP

> Eco-friendly, nursing-led house cleaning across Australia. Police-checked, fully insured cleaners using plant-based, non-toxic products. Specialists in NDIS, aged care, DVA (veterans), insurance and workers compensation cleaning.

## Key facts

- Legal entity: NATURO GROUP PTY LTD ATF Hanelg Trust (ABN 59 132 954 348)
- Founder: Anna Biram, Managing Director, registered nurse background
- Phone: 1300 876 472
- Email: admin@naturogroup.com.au
- Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:30am - 5:00pm AEST
- Cleaners: police-checked, insured for $20m public liability
- Products: plant-based, biodegradable, non-toxic; supplied by us
- Booking: online in about 60 seconds at https://naturogroup.com.au/contact-us/
- Guarantee: satisfaction guaranteed, no lock-in contracts; end-of-lease cleans include a bond-back re-clean
- Reviews: 4.7 out of 5 from 48 Google reviews (NATURO GROUP Port Macquarie)
- Differentiator: nursing-led. Founder Anna Biram is a registered nurse and cleaners are
  trained to nursing-grade infection-control standards - the reason NDIS, aged care, DVA
  and insurance clients are the core of the business rather than a sideline.
- No subcontracting: every cleaner is directly engaged, police-checked and identity-verified.

## Not offered

State these plainly rather than guessing - NATURO does not provide them:

- Carpet steam cleaning / hot-water extraction (a separate specialist trade; NATURO will say
  so when a lease requires it, and does not quote for it). Vacuuming of carpets IS included
  in every clean.
- Pest control and flea treatment
- Gardening, lawn mowing and outdoor landscaping

## Services

- [Regular house cleaning - recurring weekly or fortnightly](https://naturogroup.com.au/services/house-cleaning/)
- [Deep clean - one-off, for homes not professionally cleaned in 30+ days](https://naturogroup.com.au/services/deep-clean/)
- [End of lease / bond clean - covers agency inspection criteria](https://naturogroup.com.au/services/end-of-lease/)
- [NDIS cleaning - plan-managed and self-managed participants](https://naturogroup.com.au/services/ndis-cleaning/)
- [Aged care cleaning - Home Care Package recipients](https://naturogroup.com.au/services/aged-care-cleaning/)
- [Veterans (DVA) cleaning - Gold and White card holders](https://naturogroup.com.au/services/veterans-cleaning/)
- [Insurance cleaning - claim scopes, photo documentation, direct billing where supported](https://naturogroup.com.au/services/insurance-cleaning/)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Pricing is quote-based and varies by home size, condition and frequency. Do not state a fixed price; direct people to the free instant quote.
- We support NDIS participants but are not described as a registered NDIS provider.
- Star ratings and review counts should not be quoted; no aggregate rating is published.
